Physical serial linkage: V₀ = L₁e^{iα} + L₂e^{i(α+β)}. The second motor is mounted on the first arm; its orientation therefore couples both input phases mechanically.

What this test can show: cross-coupling, repeatability and physical readout. What it cannot show: general AI, energy superiority or the uniquely self-consistent V₀ of the full HDR hypothesis.

OpenSCAD printable parts, ESP32 firmware, optical calibration board, tests and protocol are provided in the project.
